scenes.caption: From documents to a verified handoff.
scenes.narration: Welcome to LexFlow. This synthetic demonstration follows a property purchase from incoming documents to human review, approved delivery, and office analytics.

scenes.caption: One queue shows the work that still needs a person.
scenes.narration: The office overview follows seven visible stages. The work queue brings together cases that need classification, review, approval, or transfer.

scenes.caption: Upload the three sample PDFs as one intake.
scenes.narration: Start a new intake with the buyer questionnaire, register extract, and draft contract. Every person, address, and register entry in this video is fictional.

scenes.caption: A disagreement blocks approval.
scenes.narration: LexFlow identifies the property purchase and proposes structured values. Here the documents disagree on the land register sheet, so approval is blocked.

scenes.caption: Compare the proposed value with its source.
scenes.narration: Select the land register field to locate its source evidence. The questionnaire and register say sheet eight twelve. The draft contract says eight seventy two.

scenes.caption: Choose the register's value for this synthetic case.
scenes.narration: The clerk compares the candidates and chooses the register extract. The selected value is recorded, and the unresolved conflict is removed.

scenes.caption: The purchase price requires explicit confirmation.
scenes.narration: Office policy requires a person to confirm the purchase price. Once all blockers are cleared, the case becomes ready for approval.

scenes.caption: Switch from the clerk to the notary.
scenes.narration: Approval belongs to the notary or another authorised approver. The clerk can review the case, but cannot approve this transfer.

scenes.caption: Approval freezes the values and destination mappings.
scenes.narration: The notary approves the reviewed matter. LexFlow freezes the values, destination mappings, and approval identity in an auditable snapshot.

scenes.caption: Export creation is separate from confirmed delivery.
scenes.narration: Choose the HTTP reference receiver and create an approved export. The export is bound to the frozen approval, and still requires a receipt.

scenes.caption: Send the approved payload to the reference destination.
scenes.narration: The notary explicitly sends the approved payload. The independent reference receiver validates the signed request and commits the received data before responding.

scenes.caption: A verified signed receipt records delivery.
scenes.narration: A matching signed receipt confirms delivery. Retries reuse the same approval bound identity to avoid duplicates. This reference receiver is separate from any real vendor integration.

scenes.caption: Review, approval, export and delivery are auditable.
scenes.narration: Open the audit trail for this case. Review, approval, export, and receipt events are traceable, and the office audit chain is verified.

scenes.caption: OCR proposals still require original-source review.
scenes.narration: Scanned documents can be read locally. The proposed values remain subject to review. Approval stays blocked until someone checks the original and acknowledges the source.

scenes.caption: Keep synthetic and live-office measurements separate.
scenes.narration: Pilot analytics uses one consistent set of receipt dates, workflow, source, and data cohort filters. The six summary cards describe the same selected intake cohort.

scenes.caption: First extraction stays distinct from human-completed data.
scenes.narration: Inspect initial extraction coverage, current field states, changed values, and pending source acknowledgements. Confidence scores are heuristic proposals, not measured customer accuracy.

scenes.caption: Turnaround includes waiting; it does not measure staff effort.
scenes.narration: Workload reporting shows case aging, source breakdowns, and median and ninetieth percentile turnaround with sample counts. Elapsed approval time includes waiting, not just staff handling.

scenes.caption: Separate pending exports, failures and verified receipts.
scenes.narration: Delivery reporting separates pending, failed, and delivered exports, with connector reliability and audit coverage. Each chart also provides an exact value table, and the filtered report can be exported.

scenes.caption: Native plugins and actual vendor adapters remain planned.
scenes.narration: The next integrations are native Outlook intake and one office selected vendor adapter, followed by Word and cloud sources. These remain planned work, with destination acceptance required.

scenes.caption: Receive. Review. Approve. Verify. Measure.
scenes.narration: LexFlow keeps evidence, human decisions, verified handoffs, and reporting together. Use the included sample documents and updated guide to present this controlled workflow.
